correctness.rationale: PASS: In characteristic two, p-rank zero entails one geometric branch point; Artin–Schreier normal form gives y^2+y=x^7+a x^5+b x^3+c x+d with a,b,c in F4 and d in a two-element trace-class section. Affine translations act freely on the 128 reduced presentations because a changes by t^2, giving exactly 32 classes with a=0. Exact N_1,N_2,N_3 counts determine all six Weil coefficients by Newton identities and functional equation. An independently written F_{4^n} implementation (with different field models and direct enumeration of y^2+y=f(x), rather than the source trace test) recovered precisely 18 triples among 32 classes: six singletons, ten doubletons, two triples; it also recovered the N_1 profile. Cartier rank one and square zero give a=2 and p-rank zero; e3 valuation 2 and divisibilities of e1,e2 prove Newton slopes 1/3 and 2/3, each threefold. This is exhaustive only for the stipulated hyperelliptic F4 stratum.

Its divergence—18 Weil types versus 32 arithmetic classes, all sharing one Newton polygon—demonstrates a substantive distinction among arithmetic isomorphism, isogeny and Newton strata; the calculation is not merely recounting the known 32 classes.
